segments.text:
V. 34.
They gave him vinegar mingled with gall—Out of Deriſion: Which, however nauſeous, He received and taſted of. St. Mark mentions alſo a different Mixture which was given Him, Wine mingled with myrrh: Such as it was cuſtomary to give to dying Criminals, to make them leſs ſenſible of their Sufferings: But this our LORD refuſed to taſte, determining to bear the full Force of his Pains.
